description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Specifications" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RequirementsRussian" name="Requirements for vodka bar"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RequirementsIrish" name="Requirements for whiskey bar"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RequirementsOther" name="Requirements for other parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartsRussian" name="Vodka bar delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartsIrish" name="Whiskey bar delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartsOther" name="Other parts delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Delivery" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Russian" name="Russian Team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Irish" name="Irish Team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OtherTeams" name="Other Part Manufacturing Teams"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequirementsRussian" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Participant_Russian" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequirementsIrish" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Participant_Irish" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequirementsOther" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsOther" targetRef="Participant_OtherTeams" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsOther"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PartsRussian" name="Deliver vodka bar" sourceRef="Participant_Russian" targetRef="Catch_PartsRussian" messageRef="Msg_PartsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PartsIrish" name="Deliver whiskey bar" sourceRef="Participant_Irish" targetRef="Catch_PartsIrish" messageRef="Msg_PartsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PartsOther" name="Deliver other parts" sourceRef="Participant_OtherTeams" targetRef="Catch_PartsOther" messageRef="Msg_PartsOther"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Delivery" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Luxury Airplane Production" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Specifications" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Specifications" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SendRequirementsSplit" name="Split requirements"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" name="Send requirements to Russian team"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" name="Send requirements to Irish team"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsOther" name="Send requirements to other teams"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsRussian" name="Vodka bar received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsRussian" messageRef="Msg_PartsRussian"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsIrish" name="Whiskey bar received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsIrish" messageRef="Msg_PartsIrish"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PartsOther" name="Other parts received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsOther" messageRef="Msg_PartsOther"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PartsJoin" name="All parts received"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductTestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmed by customer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Airplane delivered and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Specifications" targetRef="Gateway_SendRequirementsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Gateway_SendRequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_SendRequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_SendRequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsOther"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Catch_PartsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Catch_PartsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsOther" targetRef="Catch_PartsOther"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Catch_PartsRussian" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Catch_PartsIrish" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Catch_PartsOther" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_ConductTestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ConductTestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Catch_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Catch_DeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer_Placeholder" name="Customer" isExecutable="false"/>

</bpmn:definitions>
